note: Allen County, KS publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (allencounty.org Allen County Zoning Map). The county GIS host gis.acimap.us has parcels, municipal boundaries and a future land use layer but no zoning district layer; the DPS iMap viewer shows no public zoning service, and the City_Planning folder requires a token. Iola and Humboldt zoning is held as code-adopted official maps or PDFs, with no queryable GIS layer found (Humboldt's map is held by the City Clerk). The NG911 city layers on services8.arcgis.com hold emergency-service boundaries, not zoning.
